edges.reason: msg.sender is forwarded as the from address by transfer().
msg.sender drives the allowance-spending branch and is compared against _from in transferFrom().
approve() writes allowance keyed by msg.sender.
delegate() is gated only by the msg.sender == owner check.
init() is gated only by the msg.sender == owner check.
batchSend() is gated only by the msg.sender == owner check.
setTradeAddress() is gated only by the msg.sender == owner check.
The constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, granting all privileged powers.
transfer() returns transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
transferFrom() calls ensure() before mutating balances.
ensure() delegates sale-window validation to condition().
transferFrom() increments _onSaleNum[_from] on every transfer.
transferFrom() mutates balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to] with raw unchecked arithmetic.
transferFrom() decrements the spender allowance when msg.sender != _from.
transferFrom() relies on unchecked subtraction/addition on allowance and balances.
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] to cap the number of sales per address.
condition() rejects transfers below _minSale.
condition() rejects transfers above _maxSale.
condition() returns false outright when _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale are all zero.
delegate() feeds the owner-supplied address and calldata into an arbitrary delegatecall.
init() writes _minSale from the scaled token parameter.
init() writes _maxSale from the scaled maxToken parameter.
init() writes _saleNum, arming the per-address sale cap.
init() computes token*(10**uint256(decimals)) and maxToken*(10**uint256(decimals)) unchecked.
batchSend() decrements the owner balance by total and adds _value to each recipient unchecked.
batchSend() computes _value * _tos.length without overflow protection.
setTradeAddress() lets the owner inject any address into the transfer whitelist.
The constructor mints totalSupply to balanceOf[msg.sender].
The constructor pre-approves uint(-1) allowance for the Uniswap router.
The constructor stores owner = msg.sender.
The constructor sets totalSupply = _supply * 10**decimals.

ensure() treats _from == tradeAddress as a whitelisted transfer.
ensure() treats _from == owner or _to == owner as a whitelisted transfer.
ensure() compares _from against the UNI router constant.
